name: hunkproof
description: hunkproof: a run receipt for every hunk of an agent-written pull request, from the Claude Code transcripts on your disk

plugins.name: hunkproof
plugins.description: Stamps every hunk of a PR with what the agent ran after writing it and lists the unrun hunks. Adds the hunkproof skill, the /hunkproof:receipt command and a Stop hook that names the hunks edited in the session with no run after their last edit.
